mapper.sql: emp50_transport_expense_id AS transportExpenseId , emp50_person_id AS personId , emp50_yyyymm AS yyyymm , emp50_date AS date , emp50_start_point AS startPoint , emp50_close_point AS closePoint , emp50_start_time AS startTime , emp50_close_time AS closeTime , emp50_amt AS amt , emp50_transport_cd AS transportCode , f_cdnm('TransportCode', emp50_transport_cd, emp50_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS transportName , emp50_note AS note , (SELECT CASE WHEN count(*) = 1 THEN 'O' ELSE '' END FROM sys10_file WHERE sys10_parent_id = emp50_transport_expense_id LIMIT 1) AS receiptStr , (SELECT sys10_file_id FROM sys10_file WHERE sys10_parent_id = emp50_transport_expense_id LIMIT 1) AS fileId
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO emp50_transport_expense (emp50_transport_expense_id, emp50_company_id, emp50_person_id, emp50_yyyymm, emp50_date, emp50_start_point, emp50_close_point, emp50_start_time, emp50_close_time, emp50_amt, emp50_transport_cd, emp50_note) VALUES (#{id}, #{companyId}, #{personId}, #{req.yyyymm}, #{req.date}, #{req.startPoint}, #{req.closePoint}, #{req.startTime}, #{req.closeTime}, #{req.amt}, #{req.transportCode}, #{req.note})
mapper.select: SELECT emp51_relate_appr_id AS relateApprId , emp51_reg_no AS regNo , emp51_appr_id AS apprId , apr01_status_cd AS statusCode , f_cdnm('AprStatusCode', apr01_status_cd, emp51_company_id, apr01_reg_date) AS statusName FROM emp51_relate_appr LEFT OUTER JOIN apr01_appr b ON emp51_appr_id = apr01_appr_id WHERE emp51_company_id = #{companyId} AND emp51_person_id = #{personId} AND emp51_yyyymm LIKE #{yyyymm} ORDER BY emp51_reg_no
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO emp51_relate_appr (emp51_relate_appr_id, emp51_company_id, emp51_person_id, emp51_yyyymm, emp51_reg_no, emp51_reg_date, emp51_reg_amt, emp51_appr_id) VALUES (#{relateApprId}, #{companyId}, #{personId}, #{yyyymm}, #{regNo}, #{regDate}, #{regAmt}, NULL)
